values.note: Every RV site here is Electric Plus (50 amp): $30 a night in season, weekends included (ReserveAmerica, May and June 2027), $5 less mid-October through April (NGPC rates grid). Plus tax, the $8.50 reservation fee when booked online, and a park entry permit ($7 a day for a Nebraska vehicle, $14 otherwise; $35 / $70 a year).

summary: Confirmed lakeview and the ReserveAmerica booking; fees re-based from basic $10-15 to Electric Plus $25-30 (no basic RV sites in this loop; $30 quoted for May/June 2027 weekday and Saturday). 19 reservable 50-amp paved back-ins. Pin moves ~360 m from the entrance road into the loops. Phone 308-346-5666 to add.
flags: PHONE missing: add 308-346-5666 (ReserveAmerica park page '(308) 346-5666'; NGPC rates grid row 'Calamus SRA 308-346-5666').
SAND RULE: not a candidate. ReserveAmerica gives 'Driveway Surface: Paved' for all 19 Nunda Shoals sites, and the loops on imagery are paved roads in grass and pine, well back from the sand beach.

WATERFRONT: lakeview stands (not up). The NIR water mask puts the pads 105-276 m from the open lake: knoll loop 015-021 ~105-170 m, wooded loop 028-039 ~180-276 m. A treed draw and a small cove lie between, and the sand shoreline is beyond open grass slope. Knoll sites 017/018 face the lake over open ground, which plausibly gives a view. No official campsite photo was read, so the view is an imagery judgement.
PIN (move proposed): stored 41.86507,-99.27058 is on the entrance road south of the loops, 357 m from the centre of the 19 RA site points and 308 m from the nearest site. Suggest 41.8677,-99.2731.

SITES count 30 stays (stored from note prose). ReserveAmerica lists 19 reservable sites here, and the note's 'about half reservable, half FCFS' fits ~30-38. Imagery shows more pads in the trees east of the knoll loop. No official count was read (outdoornebraska.gov is blocked).

OTHER CALAMUS CAMPING AREAS (leads, not added). Homestead Knolls is already entry 2680 (45 RA sites, ~4.9 km SE). VALLEY VIEW FLAT is not in the DB: on the north shore, ~5 km NNW of Nunda Shoals, centre ~41.9084,-99.2974, its own entrance off the county highway. RA lists 9 Electric Plus sites (033-042, 50 amp, paved) plus 13 'Basic Hike-in' sites. On Esri imagery the loop is ~200 m from the lake across a parking/day-use area and roads, so not waterfront. LITTLE YORK POINT is on RA only as a shelter. The park page's '122 pads ... plus 55 non-pad sites' implies more FCFS areas that RA does not list.
note: One of the camping areas on Calamus Reservoir, on the south shore: two paved back-in loops of electric pads (one on an open knoll, one in pines) set 100-280 m back from the lake, with modern restrooms, coin showers, a fish-cleaning station and a boat ramp. Reopened June 2025 after upgrades. About half the pads are reservable, the rest first come. --Claude
